title: galium stellatum var. typicum
intro: Galium stellatum var. typicum, commonly known as Starry Gilia, is a flowering plant that belongs to the Rubiaceae family. It is a perennial herb native to North America, known for its clusters of small, white to pinkish flowers. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in the treatment of various conditions such as wounds, digestive issues, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Galium stellatum var. typicum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, antispasmodic, and antiseptic effects.
